interpretation.cf_ratios: Ratios with zero last-used/recomputed denominator are omitted and counted separately.
interpretation.delta: Paired difference is RRTMGP37 minus engine4 for the same captured state and seed index; radius_mode identifies the engine4 radius contract.
interpretation.ensemble: Seed-set spread is descriptive; deterministic seeds are not assumed IID.
interpretation.heating: HEAT_k is interpreted as layer K/day; profile RMS and max absolute paired difference are summarized.
interpretation.native_radius_counterfactual: radius_mode=1 enables the RRTMG4 wrapper's native-radius flag path; it retains legacy preprocessing and startup-background behavior and is not identical optical-input parity.
interpretation.tile_scope: i=j=0 rows summarize the audited WRF tile, not a global MPI domain mean.
